headline: On last trading day: Markets extended 4-week rally to hit 9-month highs amid record FII buying

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Record FII buying propelled Sensex and Nifty to 9-month highs over a 4-week rally.
Auto and bank stocks spurred a massive recovery, pushing Sensex up nearly 1,000 points.
Concerns over Fed rate hike signals and global AI stock selloffs triggered midweek pullbacks.
FPI flows, crude oil movements, and global cues are set to direct the upcoming holiday-shortened week.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty scaled 9-month highs on strong foreign fund inflows.
Adani Group entered West Bengal's power sector, sparking political calls for transparency.
NSE stock price surged 5% on high volumes, up 35% from its October lows.
Gold prices faced a dramatic selloff, putting its five-year winning streak under threat.
summary:
On the last trading session, Indian markets extended their four-week rally as Sensex and Nifty touched nine-month highs on strong FII inflows.
Key sector recoveries in banking and auto helped indices bounce back sharply despite earlier pressure from global AI selloffs and US Fed rate worries.
Market participants are now tracking FPI trends, crude oil movements, and global cues for guidance ahead of the new week.
